title: Numbered Items
goal: Pair each slice element with its zero-based index to create formatted strings.
hints: A slice does not have an enumerate method directly. You must turn it into an iterator first.
enumerate yields a tuple where the index comes first: (index, item).
explanation: `.iter().enumerate()` turns the slice into an iterator that yields `(usize, &&str)` pairs with the index in the first position. The closure `|(i, item)|` destructures this single tuple argument correctly. Calling `.enumerate()` directly on a slice fails with `E0599` because slices do not implement `Iterator`. Reversing the tuple pattern `|(item, i)|` places the item string where the integer index was expected, swapping the output to `"apple: 0"`. Writing `|i, item|` without parentheses tries to take two separate closure arguments instead of one tuple, triggering `E0593`.
